description:
“In a given circle to inscribe an equilateral and equiangular hexagon.”
— Euclid's Elements, BOOK IV • PROP. 15 (G.167)

00:00 1 · GIVEN: given circle ( A B C D E F )
00:16 2 · CONSTRUCT: diameter / A D /, center G, circle ( E G C H ) with center D
00:26 3 · CONSTRUCT: extend / E G /, / C G / to B, F; join hexagon ⟨ A B C D E F ⟩
00:35 4 · ASSERT: ⟨ E G D ⟩, ⟨ D G C ⟩ equilateral → all 6 central angles at G equal
01:03 5 · ASSERT: equal central angles → equal arcs → 6 equal sides
01:31 6 · ∴: regular hexagon ⟨ A B C D E F ⟩ inscribed in circle (side = radius)
01:58 7 · COMMENTARY: Porism (s₆ = R), Proclus & Heiberg, and Book XIII golden section
